The team’s 2025 technical report lists Jan Disselhoff at Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz.

competitorFacts.sourceTitle: Separate ARC2 and ARC3 team entries — dated public roster evidence
competitorFacts.text: On 19 October 2026, Mark Barney announced Jack Cole joining ARC Mutants for ARC-AGI-2. The public ARC2 roster lists jcole75, markbarney, scizical and sonphamorg under team 17023174. Team Turducken (ARC-AGI-3 team 15605182) is a separate entry; this announcement does not add Jack to that ARC3 team.

discussionThreads.author: darrenamadeusmartin
discussionThreads.reason: Staff reply and follow-ups verified without login. Actual cited X announcement inspected; no explicit public/private wording there.
discussionThreads.summary: Kaggle staff María Cruz says on October 23 at 23:39 UTC that submissions made before November 2 at 23:59 UTC keep scoring afterward, but a pending run must be selected among the two final submissions before the deadline. Private standings appear after all pre-deadline queued runs finish; the later winners announcement follows verification. Cruz says the 85% grand-prize criterion uses the private board and invites Greg Kamradt to clarify. Participants question consistency with ARC Prize’s October 9 bonus-prize announcement. The desk checked that actual X post: it promises a split among teams above 85% but does not explicitly name public or private. Participant inference is not a confirmed contradiction.

wireStories.headline: Richard Csaky's team moves into ARC-2 gold at 15th

sections.text: artificialagencylab.com climbed from 25th to 15th on the ARC-2 public board, reaching 70.56 with a gain of 3.75 in the past day.

Richard Csaky is on the roster of that team. Public standings are provisional, and medals are decided on the private board, so this is a move into the gold places on the public table rather than a settled medal.

wireStories.headline: No Name jumps from 594th to 49th on ARC-2

sections.text: No Name gained 22.78 to reach 54.17 on the ARC-2 public board, moving from 594th to 49th in the past day.
The gold line on that board stands at 69.72, so the team is still well below the medal places. The move lifts it into the top 50 and makes it a team to watch in the middle of the table.
